location_address: San Diego San Diego, CA US
description: Explore the breathtaking beauty of San Diego’s coastline on a guided hiking experience through Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve, followed by a relaxing beachside picnic. This tour is perfect for nature lovers and anyone looking to enjoy San Diego’s iconic coastal views with the ease of a locally guided experience.
what_is_included:
Guided hike through Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve

Expert local guide

Light picnic snack at Torrey Pines State Beach

Round-trip transportation from meeting point
what_is_not_included:
Gratuities for guide (optional)

Meals beyond picnic snack

Personal expenses
itinerary:
Itinerary Breakdown
8:00 a.m. – Check-in & Departure from Downtown San Diego

Meet your guide at the Santa Fe Depot (Five Star Tours office)

Depart in comfortable transportation to Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve

8:30 a.m. – Guided Hike at Torrey Pines

Start your hike through scenic coastal trails

Learn about native plants, local geology, and the rare Torrey Pine tree

Enjoy panoramic ocean views and plenty of photo opportunities

9:45 a.m. – Picnic at Torrey Pines State Beach

Arrive at the beach for a relaxing picnic box lunch

Free time to relax by the ocean, take photos, or dip your toes in the water

10:30 a.m. – Return to San Diego

Board transportation and head back to the starting point

11:00 a.m. – Tour Ends at Santa Fe Depot
highlights:
Guided hike through Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve

Learn about the rare Torrey Pine trees and local ecology

Scenic views of the Pacific Ocean and sandstone cliffs

Light picnic at Torrey Pines State Beach

Small group experience for a personalized and relaxed pace

Round-trip transportation from Downtown San Diego
